connection.waitingDescription: Open ADOFAI and make sure the mod is enabled.
connection.updateDescription: Fully quit ADOFAI, then start it again to update TUFReplay.
connection.ipcUpdateDescription: The game is running an older or legacy AdofaiIPC than this website requires.
ipcUpdateSteps: Download the latest stable AdofaiIPC release.
Replace the installed AdofaiIPC files while ADOFAI is closed.
Restart ADOFAI, then retry the connection.
connection.clientUpdateDescription: AdofaiIPC is newer than the cached website client.
clientUpdateSteps: Refresh this page to load the latest website bundle.
If the message remains, clear this site's cache and reload.
updateSteps: Start ADOFAI again and wait for TUFReplay to update.
Return here; this page will retry automatically.

replayUnavailable.legacy_engine: This run was recorded with the previous replay engine.
replayUnavailable.capture_incomplete: Replay capture was incomplete for this run.
replayUnavailable.input_queue_overflow: This run was saved, but some inputs were lost because the recording buffer filled up. Replay is unavailable. Try recording again; if it repeats, restart the game.
replayUnavailable.input_tap_timeout: This run was saved, but macOS paused input capture after it stopped responding. Replay is unavailable because inputs may be missing. Restart the game before recording again.
replayUnavailable.input_tap_disabled: This run was saved, but macOS disabled input capture during recording. Replay is unavailable because inputs may be missing. Check Input Monitoring permission and record again.
replayUnavailable.input_event_delayed: This run was saved, but inputs reached the recorder more than one second late. Replay is unavailable because input timing could not be verified. Restart the game before recording again.
replayUnavailable.input_source_stopped: This run was saved, but input capture stopped during recording. Replay is unavailable because inputs may be missing. Restart the game before recording again.
replayUnavailable.input_permission_denied: This run was saved without complete inputs, so replay is unavailable. Allow A Dance of Fire and Ice in macOS Input Monitoring, then restart the game and record again.
replayUnavailable.input_start_failed: This run was saved, but input capture could not start. Replay is unavailable. Restart the game and check the game log if it repeats.
replayUnavailable.input_read_failed: This run was saved, but some input states could not be read. Replay is unavailable because the recording is incomplete. Restart the game before recording again.
replayUnavailable.unsupported_engine: This run uses an unsupported replay engine.
replayUnavailable.unsupported_format: This run uses an unsupported replay format.
replayUnavailable.payload_missing: Replay data is missing for this run.
